opportunities.opportunity_id: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review. In special cases, and by prior agreement, we accept applications for up to £750,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address one or more of the priority questions, have a clear path to impact, a rigorous methodology, and be led by a team with appropriate experience. Individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the institution hosting the grant are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Nuffield Foundation's five interconnected priorities and aim to improve lives in the UK.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from diverse backgrounds, particularly from racially minoritised communities, are encouraged to apply. Partnership applications that bring together researchers and racially minoritised communities are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter-generational changes, continuities, and challenges in racially diverse UK.
